article.name: Incentives, Selection, and Teacher Performance: Evidence from IMPACT
article.description: Thomas Dee and James Wyckoff's October 2013 NBER working paper examines teacher retention and performance around DCPS IMPACT rating thresholds using regression discontinuity.

initiative.name: DC IMPACT
initiative.description: District of Columbia Public Schools' evaluation and feedback system for school-based personnel, introduced in 2009. It combines multiple measures of performance with feedback and personnel incentives.
